Sun_MC.label: Sun MC line
Sun_MC.meaning: A place where goals and roles tend to become clear, and your abilities are easily recognized. Attention tends to turn toward career and self-realization.
Sun_MC.meaning_hint: social role, self-realization, visibility of ability

Sun_IC.label: Sun IC line
Sun_IC.meaning: A place where you tend to want to build a life foundation in your own way. Attention turns to family and home, and you can recharge from within.

Sun_ASC.label: Sun ASC line
Sun_ASC.meaning: A place where your presence comes across naturally and you feel like taking the initiative. You may feel encouraged to start something new.

Sun_DSC.label: Sun DSC line
Sun_DSC.meaning: A place where encounters with others tend to shape the course of your life. Your own direction often becomes clearer through other people.

Moon_MC.label: Moon MC line
Moon_MC.meaning: A place where sensitivity and empathy work well in your professional life. You may become more attuned to others' feelings, so rest matters too.
Moon_MC.meaning_hint: empathy at work, emotionally resonant work

Moon_IC.label: Moon IC line
Moon_IC.meaning: A place where you tend to feel safe and at ease. Suited to emotional recharging and resetting your daily rhythm.
Moon_IC.meaning_hint: sense of safety, comfort, emotional recharge

Moon_ASC.label: Moon ASC line
Moon_ASC.meaning: A place where feelings show easily on your face and people find you approachable. Emotional waves are also felt more strongly, so keep your own pace.

Moon_DSC.label: Moon DSC line
Moon_DSC.meaning: A place where you tend to seek emotional connection. Relationships with people you feel safe with tend to deepen.

Mercury_MC.label: Mercury MC line
Mercury_MC.meaning: A place where work with words and information tends to be recognized. Attention turns to learning, communication, and negotiation.

Mercury_IC.label: Mercury IC line
Mercury_IC.meaning: A place where local learning, reading, and journaling help settle the mind. Suited to calming down and organizing your thoughts.

Mercury_ASC.label: Mercury ASC line
Mercury_ASC.meaning: A place where conversation and curiosity get moving. You become more light-footed and information gathering goes smoothly.

Mercury_DSC.label: Mercury DSC line
Mercury_DSC.meaning: A place where relationships grow through dialogue. Suited to moving things forward by talking them through.

Venus_MC.label: Venus MC line
Venus_MC.meaning: A place connected to public charm, reputation, and how your creative work is seen. Aesthetic sense and harmony tend to work in your favor professionally.
Venus_MC.meaning_hint: public charm, reputation, visibility of creative work

Venus_IC.label: Venus IC line
Venus_IC.meaning: A place where you want to make your home and daily life comfortable. Easy to find satisfaction living surrounded by things you love.
Venus_IC.meaning_hint: comfortable living, life with what you love

Venus_ASC.label: Venus ASC line
Venus_ASC.meaning: A place where your charm comes across and you tend to be received warmly. Enjoyment and connections tend to expand.
Venus_ASC.meaning_hint: charm that comes across, expanding enjoyment

Venus_DSC.label: Venus DSC line
Venus_DSC.meaning: A place where intimate and cooperative relationships tend to grow. Partnership themes come into the spotlight.

Mars_MC.label: Mars MC line
Mars_MC.meaning: A place where drive and decisiveness show in your work. The urge to take on challenges rises, so pace yourself.

Mars_IC.label: Mars IC line
Mars_IC.meaning: A place where you pour energy into building your life foundation. Physical activity tends to support emotional stability.

Mars_ASC.label: Mars ASC line
Mars_ASC.meaning: A place where assertiveness comes forward and you move with speed. With extra momentum, mind the details too.

Mars_DSC.label: Mars DSC line
Mars_DSC.meaning: A place where interactions with others carry heat. Frank exchanges increase, so keep a healthy distance.

Jupiter_MC.label: Jupiter MC line
Jupiter_MC.meaning: A place where broadened horizons and opportunities show up in your work. Easy to envision your future here.

Jupiter_IC.label: Jupiter IC line
Jupiter_IC.meaning: A place where life feels spacious and abundant. Home and foundations tend to expand.

Jupiter_ASC.label: Jupiter ASC line
Jupiter_ASC.meaning: A place where your generosity comes across and possibilities open up. Also pairs well with themes of learning and travel.

Jupiter_DSC.label: Jupiter DSC line
Jupiter_DSC.meaning: A place blessed with good connections and supporters. Your world tends to expand through people.
Jupiter_DSC.meaning_hint: good connections, supporters, growth through people

Saturn_MC.label: Saturn MC line
Saturn_MC.meaning: A place suited to settling in and building a career steadily. Trust takes shape in proportion to the responsibility you accept.

Saturn_IC.label: Saturn IC line
Saturn_IC.meaning: A place suited to carefully solidifying your life foundation. Good for putting life in order and cultivating long-term stability.

Saturn_ASC.label: Saturn ASC line
Saturn_ASC.meaning: A place where composure and a sense of responsibility come forward. You tend to advance steadily with self-discipline.

Saturn_DSC.label: Saturn DSC line
Saturn_DSC.meaning: A place suited to growing relationships over time. Trust deepens as promises and roles are carefully maintained.

Uranus_MC.label: Uranus MC line
Uranus_MC.meaning: A place where attention turns to unconventional ways of working and original angles. Easy to experiment with a shift into new fields.
Uranus_MC.meaning_hint: original path, reinventing how you work

Uranus_IC.label: Uranus IC line
Uranus_IC.meaning: A place where you feel like refreshing your way of living. Easy to bring new air into your home and habits.

Uranus_ASC.label: Uranus ASC line
Uranus_ASC.meaning: A place where individuality and originality stand out. You feel like moving with free ideas.

Uranus_DSC.label: Uranus DSC line
Uranus_DSC.meaning: A place where unconventional encounters and exchanges arise. Relationships that respect each other's freedom tend to grow.

Neptune_MC.label: Neptune MC line
Neptune_MC.meaning: A place where attention turns to work that uses imagination and sensibility. As receptivity opens up, keep practical plans at hand too.

Neptune_IC.label: Neptune IC line
Neptune_IC.meaning: A place where quiet and healing are easy to feel. Boundaries soften; suited to unwinding and nurturing your sensitivity.

Neptune_ASC.label: Neptune ASC line
Neptune_ASC.meaning: A place where a gentle aura comes across. Intuition works well here, so keep plans and promises in writing.

Neptune_DSC.label: Neptune DSC line
Neptune_DSC.meaning: A place where empathetic connections arise. Compassion for others deepens, while boundaries deserve attention.

Pluto_MC.label: Pluto MC line
Pluto_MC.meaning: A place suited to deep career involvement and rebuilding from the structure up. Easy to focus your concentration on one point.

Pluto_IC.label: Pluto IC line
Pluto_IC.meaning: A place suited to facing your life foundation and inner themes in depth. Easy to let go of what you no longer need and rebuild the base.
Pluto_IC.meaning_hint: reviewing foundations, letting go and rebuilding

Pluto_ASC.label: Pluto ASC line
Pluto_ASC.meaning: A place where your hidden powers of concentration are drawn out. Suited to looking deeply at how you want to be.

Pluto_DSC.label: Pluto DSC line
Pluto_DSC.meaning: A place where themes of deep, long-lasting relationships appear. Easy to reshape roles within relationships and regrow bonds.
